items.title: The composition of strict morphisms of filtered objects is strict under an injectivity or surjectivity hypothesis
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the composite of two strict morphisms of filtered objects is not strict in general, but is strict when the second map is injective or the first is surjective (statement lines 5034-5043). The proof is a complete argument: part (1) is a concrete counterexample on a filtered two-dimensional vector space, with the induced filtrations verified to be strict through the cited lemma (proof lines 5046-5054); parts (2) and (3) are displayed computations of the image and of the preimage of a filtration step, using strictness and the injectivity or surjectivity hypothesis in each line (proof lines 5056-5077). The non-formal content is the construction of the counterexample. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
